items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: Harry’s band was getting close to Basie you know.

ctx.x: Who were the arrangers, did you have particular arrangers that you loved to see their name up in that right hand corner of page one?

Yeah. I mean common things. You know Harry had great charts. Basie, great charts. And Stan — you know those are bands I played with and I liked every one of them for a different reason. But Basie and Harry, you know at the tail end we played a lot of Basie charts. They’re not the same charts, let me clarify that. We played a lot of stuff that was written by Basie’s people or written for Harry’s band. We played a lot of that. So you say which band was kind of like — Harry’s band was getting close to Basie you…
That’s a good compromise. And were people dancing to his band?
